figurative_meaning_en: an extremely insignificant amount, very little money
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পকেটে কানাকড়ির মতো টাকা নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: I don't even have a kankori to my name.
He doesn't have even a scrap of money in his pocket.
history: Refers to cowrie shells (kari) used as small-denomination currency in historical and medieval Bengal.
note: The idiom draws from traditional use of cowrie shells in trade and daily transactions.
